mechanics.claim: Fizz dashes a fixed distance toward the target and deals damage and applies on-hit effects only if the target is still in range upon arrival.
mechanics.quote: Fizz dashes a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy. If they are in range upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} plus {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.

mechanics.claim: Seastone Trident and Chum the Waters can be cast during the dash, allowing ability combos without waiting for the dash to finish.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Seastone Trident|Fizz}} and {{ai|Chum the Waters|Fizz}} can be cast during the dash.

mechanics.claim: Urchin Strike only damages the target if it is within 200 units of its original location when the dash completes.
mechanics.quote: ''Urchin Strike'' only damages targets if within 200 units of their original location upon completion of the dash.

mechanics.claim: After Urchin Strike, Fizz automatically basic attacks the target, which can trigger an on-attack reset context.
mechanics.quote: '''Fizz''' will be automatically ordered to {{tip|basic attack}} the target after ''Urchin Strike''.

mechanics.claim: Urchin Strike deals no damage if the target becomes untargetable.
mechanics.quote: ''Urchin Strike'' does not deal damage if the target is {{tip|untargetable}}.

mechanics.claim: Life steal applies only to the physical damage portion, while spell vamp applies to both the physical damage and bonus magic damage.
mechanics.quote: {{as|{{sti|Life steal}}}} applies only on the physical damage component. {{tip|Spell vamp}} applies to both the physical damage and bonus magic damage.
